nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = Authorization, value = Bearer <your Apify API token> (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price.

parameters.content:
## Company Social Profile Finder
Company domain or name to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook links, with confidence scores.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
